# Multiple regression  {#sec-t7}


## Learning outcomes {#sec-t7ILO}

After viewing the tutorial materials and following along with the demonstration, you can:

1. Set-up, run and interpret linear regression models
2. Check the asumptions of linear regression

## Datasets {#sec-t7data}

This demonstration uses the dataset [**album_sales**](data/album_sales.jasp) which was prepared by Andy Field and included in Field, van Doorn and Wagenmakers [-@field2025]. This dataset contains (fictional) information on album sales for different bands. The variables are `Adverts` (Advertising budget in GBP), `Sales` (Album sales in units of thousands), `Airplay` (Number of plays on the radio) and `Image` (Band's image rating from 0-10).
